answers.question: What does the company do and how does it earn money?

sentences.text: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd builds and runs software and technology systems for large companies around the world.
It earned ₹2,55,300 crore in revenue in FY2026, up from ₹2,09,969 crore in FY2023.
Banking and financial services accounts for 31.5% of revenue, the largest single business.
Over the last three years, revenue grew by 6.7% a year on average; the median for its IT services peers is 8.6%.
Net profit grew by 5.9% a year on average over the same period (peer median 7.9%) and was ₹48,762 crore in FY2026.
In FY2026 the company kept 25.9% of its revenue as operating profit (five-year median 26.3%, peer median 22.4%) and earned 51.6% on shareholders' money (peer median 27.9%).

answers.question: How is it priced against its own history and its peers?

sentences.text: The share price is 28.3x the yearly profit per share. That is below the company's own five-year median of 30.8x and above the peer median of 25.1x.
The share price is 15.0x the shareholders' money per share (book value), above its own five-year median of 14.0x and above the peer median of 7.2x.
The whole company is valued at ₹14,20,200 crore on the market, against ₹10,88,005 crore a year ago, and its dividend yield is 1.9% (peer median 2.1%).
